entities.name: René Drucker Colín
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: René Raúl Drucker Colín was a Mexican scientist, researcher and journalist in the fields of physiology and neuroscience. From 1985 through 1990, he was the Director of Neuroscience at the National Autonomous University of Mexico. He was also the President of the Mexican Academy of Sciences from 2000 through 2008.
